additional_info.subject: RE: ID0435574-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R8 170002447] Cable disconnected, recharge ended in 13 secs CRM:02919000107
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
Thank you for your patience as we investigated the recent incident concerning the failed session.
Our analysis indicates that the operational anomaly experienced by the Supply Equipment Communication Controller (SECC) was a direct consequence of a deviation from the standard charging protocol. Specifically, it was observed that the vehicle's charging cable was disconnected prematurely, moments after the transaction was accepted and before the charging sequence could be fully established.
This premature interruption resulted in an anomalous pilot state signal, which caused a system misinterpretation within the SECC. To restore the unit to its normal operational state, a system reboot was subsequently required.
We recommend ensuring that the vehicle remains connected until the charging session is fully established or formally terminated through the system, to prevent similar occurrences.
Please let me know if you require any further clarification or if I may proceed with closing this ticket.
